meta.purpose: Single machine-readable list of the integration gates that CI runs. Nothing here decides pass/fail thresholds; it only records which script belongs to which gate, what its blocking exit code is, and the non-blocking exit code that must stay non-blocking.
meta.note: Adding a gate here does NOT wire it into CI. The CI job count and the gate count are cross-checked by skills/tests/verify-gate-wiring.py, which fails when a listed gate has no workflow invocation.

gates.why: Spec section numbering, cross-references and the task-card count.
Spec 17.27 physical isolation: a plain recursive skills/** walk must find exactly canonical skills plus the four wrappers.
Pins docs/community/link-triage.json to a digest in an independent file. Blocks the self-exemption hole found on 2026-09-29.
gates.ci_note: exit 10 in CI is EXPECTED: the read-only upstream snapshots live outside the repository, so an actionless checkout cannot machine-verify upstream_layout_unmappable claims. This is a documented degradation, not a regression (see HANDOFF.md 2.1).

gates.why: Detects a silent revert by scripts/adapt-community.py: vendored docs losing their reference-only banner, raw skills losing the integration contract, hack-skills regaining AI LOAD INSTRUCTION.
gates.ci_note: exit 10 is a REGISTERED non-blocking item (WORK-BOARD U1): 15 vendored documents still lack the banner. Wiring must preserve that; it must never be turned into a red build, and it must never be silenced either.

gates.why: T12+T14 provenance gate (spec 17.28): static attestation checks always run, live snapshot checks degrade to exit 10 without ../upstream. Previously called by no CI entrypoint (P1-2).
gates.ci_note: exit 10 in CI is EXPECTED: a clean checkout has no ../upstream snapshot, so live HEAD/digest claims degrade to named NEEDS_REVIEW items. Static defects (bad format, dirty, missing field) still exit 20 and block.

gates.why: T12 portability gate: bundle boundary, relative snapshot_rel, gitignore coverage, registry schema plus stats. Previously called by no CI entrypoint (P1-2).
gates.ci_note: exit 10 is the registered no-git note (without .git the bundle-commit claim cannot be machine-checked). A clean CI checkout has .git, so CI normally sees exit 0; release-bundle copies without .git degrade to 10, never silently passed.

gates.why: T21 canonical-base lock (spec 17.15/17.28/17.29): base record, commits, snapshot digests. Default mode only; --require-signatures is deliberately NOT wired (see ci_note). Previously called by no CI entrypoint (P1-2).
gates.ci_note: exit 10 in CI is EXPECTED (no ../upstream snapshot in a clean checkout). Only the default mode is wired: --require-signatures exits 20 on the real tree by design (unsigned base, 17.15) and would keep CI red; wiring it non-blocking would train CI to ignore a promotion refusal. Promotion readiness stays a human-run gate.

gates.why: T26 signal-layer verifier, 12 fail-closed checks. Added by T26 and previously called by no entrypoint (WORK-BOARD U10).
T26 negative controls: drives the real verifier with 13 mutated documents and requires each to exit 20, plus a no-op mutation self-check. Added by T26, previously called by no entrypoint.
Registry v2 contract, section 4.6 migration table row by row, three JSON Schemas, handoff semantics.
4.7 exit-code statuses and fail-closed behaviour. Runs community-route.py as a subprocess; that is repository code, not vendor code.
Field-aware ranking, plus the permanent D1/D2/D5/D6 defect guards.
The repository's only negative corpus (T26 / D8): 29 decoys assert a hint must NOT reach something. Added by T26, previously called by no entrypoint.
gates.ci_note: Both gates sit deliberately BELOW the measured pass rates so a new over-broad rule moves the number instead of being tuned away.

gates.why: 59 assertions on YAML folded/quoted descriptions, including 15 negative guards.

Cross-checks this manifest against .github/workflows: a gate that no workflow invokes is reported UNWIRED and blocks. This is the gate that would have caught WORK-BOARD U10 on day one. Also enforces spec 17.31: read-only workflow permissions, no vendor-code execution in a run: line, no secret in a gate workflow, full-SHA action pinning.
gates.ci_note: exit 10 is the honest open item it carries: auto-merge-journal.yml holds contents: write and pull-requests: write as a non-gate job, and 17.31 asks for an independent review record (owner T24). The gate reads docs/CI-TRUST-BOUNDARY.md and clears the item only when that workflow's own write-scope record is found in the review section; a missing record is still exit 10, reported, not waived.

gates.why: Registry paths, frontmatter and license warnings. CI must call it WITHOUT --release: the release mode is T04's deliverable and is not wired by T10.
gates.ci_note: spec T10 forbids widening or deleting assertions; T04 owns scripts/validate-integration.py and owns --release.

gates.why: active=0 wrapper=0 broken links; provenance breaks must be registered. Already wired in ci.yml before T10 (kept where it was).
Executable/reference boundaries, unreviewed binaries, full-SHA Action pinning. Already wired in ci.yml before T10 (kept where it was).

T04 redistribution/provenance gate (spec 17.29): answers whether this tree may be redistributed. Previously called by no CI entrypoint (the T10 comment named it deliberately unwired while T04 was being created concurrently).
gates.ci_note: CI wires the default local-only mode only: exit 0 on the real tree (473 provenance findings recorded as warnings), structural defects exit 20 and block. --release exits 20 by design on this registry and stays a human promotion gate, deliberately NOT wired. Exit 10 is reserved by the spec 4.7 table and never emitted. No snapshot/.git dependency: identical exit 0 in no-git copies.

gates.why: T05 importer acceptance + negative-control suite (87 checks, including the real-tree-unchanged guard). Previously called by no CI entrypoint.
gates.ci_note: Exit 0 when 87/87 checks pass, 30 on any failure. Exactly one check needs ../upstream read-only snapshots (readonly/inspect on hack-skills); measured 86/87 exit 30 without them, so the runner SKIPs this gate loudly in a clean clone instead of keeping CI red. With snapshots present exit 30 blocks.

gates.why: 199-case main routing regression. Already wired in ci.yml before T10 (kept where it was).
Routing coherence plus the supply-chain pin gate. Already wired in ci.yml before T10 (kept where it was).

docs/EVOLUTION-CHECKLIST.md as one command: 10 checks (doc links, signal layer fail-closed, routing entry, community reachability, tool manifest, registry consistency, script inventory, coherence, spec structure, dual benchmark). Built by b124d76 and previously called by no entrypoint.
经验卡晋级门 + 8 类反例控制组。经验卡是 skills/experience-cards/ 下已晋级的结构化规则；没有这道门，一张编造 fixture 路径、或只复现过一次的卡会被当成可复用经验消费。
模拟器能力层的契约测试：厂商端口表、厂商名解析、原生退出码如实传出（注入假 exe 覆盖 0/1/3/255），以及一组反例证明判据真的会红。不需要装任何模拟器。

常驻/固定注入文本的预算与形状。① 每个技能的 name+description 会被宿主预载进系统提示（每轮付费），也是模型选择技能的唯一信号：exit 1 = 形状坏（多行/超长/缺 用于：/残留旧的'务必使用此技能'抢触发话术），exit 20 = 总量越过常驻预算。② route-scope.md 的固定注入段必须两侧（.ps1/.sh）渲染一致且不超过预算。没有这道门，下一轮会静默把常驻成本推上去，而且没人拦得住。

证据门 —— 把 ops/analysis-decision-framework.md ADF-R4* 与 templates/assault.md 的'状态列只能升到证据列支撑的高度' 从纸面规矩变成会红的门。查三件事：① functions 表状态升到「对照一致」必须有 diff/<F-ID>.md 证据；② findings 表每行证据列非空且引用的 E-nnn 真实存在；③ 块格式 status=validated 需 ≥2 条独立证据（单条须显式写 residual_risk + 人工确认）。★ 自带自检控制组（1 正例 + 5 反例必须全部转红）—— 因为真实案例在用户项目目录、不在仓里，只扫仓库会让这道门永远绿；一道永远不会红的门比没有门更坏（虚假安全感）。同一惯例见 experience-cards 的反例控制组。

失败→技能回归表的结构门（L2.1）。本包此前 26 个门全是格式/一致性门、0 行为门，所以「改好了」只能验形状不能验行为——这是「下次真实做又出问题」的机械原因。本门查：① 每条 case 必填字段齐全；② expect_chain 引用的技能/文档真实存在（防悬空承诺）；③ known_failures 为空时必须显式声明「无/正控」（防假填，真实项目几乎不可能零失败）；④ 报出 open 数与未收敛失败数。模型驱动的行为门见 L2.2（test-routing-e2e / test-trigger-rate / test-assault-behavior，挂 non-blocking 先跑数）。

端到端路由回归（L2.2 行为门二）。已有 test-routing 跑的是 224 条人工短句，验的是「路由规则没退化」；本门拿 tests/cases/*.yaml 的 task_verbatim（**用户原话，不改写**）走 master-route，检查 PRIMARY/entry_menu 是否落在该 case 的 expect_chain 上。二者不同：前者是短句，后者是真实请求。案例：case-001 的原话「逆向 换肤程序点我下载6.9版本.exe 做出能正常使用的成品」此前落在 ida-reverse（纯静态），现已改走 assault-entry（受保护目标四问分流）。

技能触发率评估的结构门（L2.2 行为门三）。依据 Anthropic Agent Skills 规范：每技能 8–10 正例 + 8–10 **近邻负例**，正例触发率 ≥0.5、负例 <0.5。本门只做结构检查（不需要模型调用）：eval 集存在、正例 ≥8、负例 ≥8、**每条负例确实近邻**（与目标或同域技能共享关键词）。弱负例（「今天天气怎么样」）测不出东西，会被判无效。实跑触发率用 --run（花钱），建议挂 non-blocking。
真实任务行为门（L2.2 行为门一）。把 2026-10-13 那次真实攻坚里**主人亲口提的四条验收标准**机械化：① 自己提出抓包/判壳 ② 自己走到 assault-entry/反调试 ③ 自己发现并说明 x64dbg MCP 通道 ④ 无卡密后不再索要卡密。这四条当时**一条都没被执行过**（终态报告换成了别的 KPI）。默认只做配置检查（不花钱）；--run 才开新会话实跑。
